question: Is any candidate predictor set as good as or better than production?

held_constant.hyperparameter_search: TimeSeriesSplit, 5 folds, inside the training window

known_limits: production here is a mirror, not the config. Missing: us_2y_yield, us_10y_minus_2y_spread, baltic_capesize_index, baltic_panamax_index, iron_ore, us_shipping_equity_proxy - none has free daily history.
sp500 uses SPY, not the configured ^GSPC, which timed out at 90s, 180s and 300s while neighbouring symbols answered in under 4s.
Trade returns ignore lot rounding; every arm carries the same approximation.
63 sessions. Every paired trading test is underpowered at this length.

paired_tests_vs_production.note: Days an arm held nothing count as zero, not as missing: staying in cash is a decision the rule made.

findings.claim: All four sets order the cross-section with real skill
findings.evidence: rank IC 0.107-0.113, p=0.001 each, clears Bonferroni

findings.claim: Rank IC cannot distinguish the four sets
findings.evidence: every paired IC difference is far inside its detection floor

findings.claim: Rank IC and trading outcome diverge
findings.evidence: indistinguishable ICs alongside threshold-rule net of +0.44 to -0.01; ranking correct about the middle and wrong about the top scores well and earns nothing

findings.claim: Top-k selection is worse than the threshold rule
findings.evidence: top5 loses on all four sets; top3 loses on all four; the threshold rule's value is in the days it declines to trade
Wilcoxon p=0.0173 against a 0.0167 threshold, t p=0.0225; 21 of 63 sessions differ
t p=0.0705, Wilcoxon p=0.1484; the direction is negative and the CI excludes zero at [-0.0049, -0.00005], so it is not equivalent either
the adoption bar was 'as good as or better than production'; it is neither shown better nor shown equivalent on any metric that matters

recommendation: Keep production's 27 indicators. No change is supported.
